name: The Indian Ocean Run
description: The Navigator needs a cargo run from Mumbai to a settlement on the Kenyan coast, but the usual sea route has been disrupted by what sounds like active naval mines — pre-war, still live, triggered by something.

stages.name: Board the Mumbai Star
stages.description: Report to the Navigator's vessel at the Mumbai docks. The cargo is loaded and waiting — the mine field is the only thing standing between Mumbai and the Kenyan coast.

stages.name: Navigate the Mine Field
stages.description: The central Indian Ocean route is compromised. Work with the Navigator to chart a safe passage through the active mine field. The mines are old but responsive.

stages.name: Deliver Cargo to Kenya
stages.description: Reach the Kenyan coast settlement with the cargo intact. The Navigator's contact will be waiting at the designated landing point.
